title: Day and Trial Passes: transferability to another person
content:
This document covers the Day and Trial Passes product line: whether a tier's pass may be used by someone other than the purchaser, and the fee to transfer it.

## Per-tier basis

| Tier | Transferable to another person | Transfer fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Single Day Pass | No | 0.00 |
| Three-Day Trial Pass | No | 0.00 |
| Seven-Day Trial Pass | No | 0.00 |
| Weekly Visitor Pass | Yes | 10.00 |
| Monthly Trial Pass | No | 0.00 |
| Corporate Guest Pass | No | 0.00 |

Only the Weekly Visitor Pass may be used by someone other than the original purchaser, and transferring it carries a 10.00 fee. Every other tier is non-transferable and carries no transfer fee.
